1.

O Jesus, Thou Lamb of God, In Thee our salvation is, For Thou didst drink the bitter cup of death Upon the cross here.

2.

Merciful priest of God, Our Saviour and Friend, To the journey’s end Thou shalt follow us With Thy love still.

3.

Our soul Thou shalt feed, Lead us, give us strength, Until at last in Thy glory We may see Thee.
